title: κ = 9.93946061393808e-4: exact seven-nine B-order composition
body:
κ = 9.93946061393808e-4

The B-order bit word has `c = 198986994618331 / 2·10^17`, `(h,m,T,R,W) = (8,56,7,822,10794)`, and the exact native seven-stage lowering is bound by the fresh source, signed restoration, forward/reflected ledgers, dirty restoration, chart links, bank slots, and complete 71-bit cancellation-free prefix receipt. The fresh finite coefficient is `56695687506592`; all eight bootstrap cutoff invoices are recomputed from it.

PR377's complex component has `b = 999240641319551 / 10^18`, dimension 73, two-level halving (`73² = 5329 > 2·48² = 4608`), complete source-bound ownership and phase invoices, and fresh full replays on CPython 3.11 and 3.12 with observed outer exit 0. Its physical row coefficient is `15445 < 20161`; logical/router/literal/precision bit lengths fit the shared guards.

The exact balanced outer assembly uses `eta = 10^-24`, `beta = 10^-9`, eight inherited bootstrap steps, and a `10^-27` grid. All 47 strict inequalities pass and the adjacent grid point fails. The package keeps dimensions 56 and 73 separate and combines only certified savings and finite/row envelopes; it does not substitute one supplier's banks or labels into the other.

The retained assumptions are the supplier's local E8 theorem, compiler/chart and prime/recovery interfaces, all-size transfer, inherited row/analytic/bootstrap/balanced-assembly interfaces, and the fact that these constructions remain conditional research packages rather than a new Lean multiplication proof.
